input: jobs has n positive safe-integer durations with1<=n<=12,1<=k<=n, and safe total S. Jobs cannot be split and may be assigned freely to k workers. Collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse/accessor-backed collections. Strings are ordinary/primitive strings. Every collection length and computed allocation size fits [0,4294967295], with padded sizes explicitly included. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is allowed. Preconditions are not runtime-checked, and allocation/resource capacity or completion is not guaranteed by declared bounds. JavaScript integer inputs are primitive safe-integer Number, excluding negative zero, NaN, infinities, fractions and BigInt.
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and caller-held aliases remain unchanged; working state is private. The Solution instance retains no state. The descending job order is a private copy.
numeric: Loads, candidate additions and search bounds are at most S. Binary search uses difference-based midpoint. Feasibility is monotone in makespan; positive durations allow symmetric empty-worker pruning. All integer inputs/intermediates remain within [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: Conservative O(n*k^(n+1)*log(S+1)+n log(n+1)) worst-case time and O(n*k+n+k) auxiliary space, including per-recursion seen-load sets and sort storage. Exponential search is explicit; recursion depth is bounded by n<=12. Bounds include ordinary built-in operations/allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop and any explicitly stated hash/sort behavior.

helpers.name: canAssign
helpers.contract: Exhaustively searches assignments with each load<=limit, skipping workers with equal current loads and all but one empty worker. Every tried load change is undone, including successful recursion.
helpers.cost: Conservative O(n*k^(n+1)) time/O(n*k+k) space; place recursion is included in the charged helper definition and depth is at most n+1. Its complete definition is 706 UTF-8 bytes; separator newlines count toward total source bytes.

source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 1170 UTF-8 bytes, including every helper, Solution wrapper, signature, loop, built-in call, annotation/comment, whitespace and terminal newline. Helpers are fully charged per candidate, not free shared libraries. No imports, runtime-generated implementations or hidden source expansion are used. Any eventual judge-interface adapter is additional charged source.

Independent source-bound isolated qualification must cover one worker/job, k=n, equal loads/durations, tight feasible boundary, symmetry pruning, undo on success/failure and exact safe total, actual return types, numerical/Unicode and effect contracts, full source/adapter charges and complexity before admission or promotion.
